title: Village Administrative Officer (VAO) & Junior Assistant (Group 4)
title_ta: கிராம நிர்வாக அலுவலர் (VAO) மற்றும் இளநிலை உதவியாளர்
qualification: 10th Standard (SSLC) Pass with Tamil language eligibility
age_limit: 18 - 32 years (Relaxation up to 37 years for BC/MBC/SC/ST)

preparation_guide.selection_process: Single Written Examination (OMR objective type) followed by Certificate Verification.
syllabus: Part A: Tamil Eligibility & Scoring Test (100 Questions / 150 Marks - 10th standard standard based on Samacheer Kalvi)
Part B: General Studies (75 Questions - History, Polity, Geography, Economy, Science, Current Affairs)
Part B: Aptitude & Mental Ability Test (25 Questions - Simplification, Percentage, Ratio, LCM & HCF)
key_topics: Thirukkural, Bharathiyar & Bharathidasan literature
Tamil Nadu History, Culture & Heritage (Unit 8 & Unit 9)
Indian Constitution & Preamble
Aptitude: Time & Work, Simple & Compound Interest
preparation_guide.study_roadmap: 1. Master 6th to 10th Tamil Samacheer Kalvi textbooks first (covers 50% of the entire paper). 2. Practice at least 15 previous years' TNPSC Group 4 question papers. 3. Allocate 1 hour daily for mental ability and math speed tricks.
preparation_guide.career_ops_tips: Ensure your SSLC mark sheet name matches your Aadhaar and One-Time Registration (OTR) profile exactly to avoid rejection during certificate verification.

title: Sub-Inspector of Police (Taluk, AR & TSP)
organization: TNUSRB (Tamil Nadu Uniformed Services Recruitment Board)
qualification: Any Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university
age_limit: 20 - 30 years (Relaxation up to 32 for BC/MBC, 35 for SC/ST)

preparation_guide.selection_process: Written Exam (Paper I Tamil + Paper II Main) -> Physical Measurement Test (PMT) -> Endurance Test (ET) -> Physical Efficiency Test (PET) -> Viva-Voce.
syllabus: Part I: Tamil Language Eligibility Test (80 Marks - Qualifying)
Part II: General Knowledge (80 Marks - Physics, Chemistry, Biology, History, Geography, Economics, Tamil Society)
Part II: Psychology Test (60 Marks - Logical Analysis, Numerical Analysis, Mental Ability, Communication)
key_topics: Physical training: 1500m run (men in under 7 mins) / 400m run (women in under 2 mins 15s)
Rope climbing & Long jump preparation
Psychology reasoning and situational analysis
preparation_guide.study_roadmap: Balance daily physical fitness drills early morning with 4 hours of academic preparation focusing heavily on the Psychology & Reasoning section.
preparation_guide.career_ops_tips: Get your sports quotas or NCC/NSS certificates attested in advance, as they grant valuable extra bonus marks during the interview stage.

title: Staff Nurse & Nursing Superintendent
organization: MRB (Medical Services Recruitment Board Tamil Nadu)
location: All District Govt Hospitals, Tamil Nadu
qualification: Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) or B.Sc. Nursing with TN Nursing Council Registration
age_limit: 18 - 32 years (No upper age limit for SC/ST/SCA/BC/BCM/MBC)

preparation_guide.selection_process: Computer Based Test (CBT) objective exam followed by document verification. No interview.
syllabus: Anatomy & Physiology, Microbiology, Fundamentals of Nursing
Medical Surgical Nursing, Pharmacology
Pediatric Nursing, Maternal & Child Health Nursing, Community Health Nursing
key_topics: Infection control standards and biomedical waste management
Emergency triage and intensive care nursing practices
Obstetric protocols and newborn resuscitation
preparation_guide.study_roadmap: Revise INC syllabus guidelines and solve previous years' MRB Staff Nurse CBT question banks.
preparation_guide.career_ops_tips: Ensure your Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council license renewal is current before submitting the application.

title: Assistant Professor (Govt Arts, Science & Engineering Colleges)
title_ta: உதவிப் பேராசிரியர் (அரசு கலை, அறிவியல் மற்றும் பொறியியல் கல்லூரிகள்)
qualification: Post Graduate Degree (55% marks) with UGC-NET / CSIR-NET / SET / SLET or Ph.D.
age_limit: Up to 57 years as on July 1 of recruitment year

preparation_guide.selection_process: Written Examination (200 marks) followed by Interview / Certificate Weightage.
syllabus: Paper I: Core Subject Knowledge (100 Marks)
Paper II: Research Methodology, Teaching Aptitude, General Knowledge & Tamil Eligibility (100 Marks)
key_topics: In-depth mastery of PG specialization syllabus
Modern pedagogical methods, higher education policies in Tamil Nadu
Published research indexing (UGC CARE / Scopus)
preparation_guide.study_roadmap: Review UGC NET Paper 1 question banks and prepare an updated research dossier with teaching demo outlines.
preparation_guide.career_ops_tips: Organize your API score documents and ensure experience certificates from guest lecturer roles carry competent authority countersignatures.

title: Assistant Engineer (Electrical, Electronics & Civil)
organization: TANGEDCO / TNEB (Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corp)
qualification: B.E / B.Tech in EEE, ECE, Mechanical, or Civil Engineering

preparation_guide.selection_process: Online Examination (CBT) followed by Viva-Voce and Certificate Verification.
syllabus: Part I: Engineering Mathematics (20 Marks)
Part II: Basic Engineering & Sciences (20 Marks - Physics, Chemistry, Computing)
Part III: Specialized Discipline (60 Marks - Power Systems, Circuit Theory, Transmission & Distribution)
key_topics: Power Electronics, Electrical Machines & Protection Switchgear
Load Flow Analysis & Smart Grid Concepts
Engineering Mathematics: Matrices, Differential Equations, Vector Calculus
preparation_guide.study_roadmap: GATE electrical previous year questions form the backbone of the technical section. Solve past TNEB AE question papers.
preparation_guide.career_ops_tips: Focus on high-speed mental calculations as non-programmable calculators may have restricted usage.

title: Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) & Technician
title_ta: ரயில்வே உதவி லோகோ பைலட் மற்றும் டெக்னீஷியன்
qualification: 10th Standard (Matriculation) with ITI in relevant trade or Diploma/Degree in Engineering
age_limit: 18 - 30 years (3 years OBC, 5 years SC/ST relaxation)

preparation_guide.selection_process: CBT 1 (Screening) -> CBT 2 (Technical & Non-Tech) -> CBAT (Computer Based Aptitude/Psycho Test) -> Medical Examination (A1 Eye Standard).
syllabus: CBT 1: Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Science, Current Affairs
CBT 2 Part A: Math, Reasoning, Basic Science & Engineering Graphics
CBT 2 Part B: Trade Specific Qualifying Test (Fitter, Electrician, Diesel Mechanic)
key_topics: A1 Medical vision standards (6/6 without glasses for ALP)
Engineering Drawing: Projections, Views, Lines, Units & Measurements
Speed, Distance & Time rail problem solving
preparation_guide.study_roadmap: Prepare NCERT Science textbooks from 6th to 10th and practice computerized psycho aptitude drills online.
preparation_guide.career_ops_tips: Ensure you meet the strict 6/6 distance vision requirement before applying, as LASIK surgery is not permitted for ALP posts.

title: Examiner, Reader, Senior Bailiff & Office Assistant
title_ta: மாவட்ட நீதிமன்ற அலுவலக உதவியாளர் மற்றும் எழுத்தர்
organization: Madras High Court & District Subordinate Courts
qualification: 8th Pass / 10th Pass (SSLC) / Any Degree depending on post

preparation_guide.selection_process: Common Written Examination followed by Skill Test / Practical Test and Oral Interview.
syllabus: Part A: General Tamil (50 Questions)
Part B: General Knowledge & Aptitude (50 Questions)
key_topics: Basic arithmetic, office procedures, Tamil language reading & writing
Basic knowledge of legal terms and district administration
preparation_guide.study_roadmap: Read 6th to 10th Samacheer Kalvi Tamil grammar and practice basic arithmetic questions.
preparation_guide.career_ops_tips: Preference is given to candidates with valid two-wheeler driving licenses or basic computer operational certificates.

title: Software Development Engineer (Full Stack / Java / C++)
qualification: Any Graduate / B.E / B.Tech / B.Sc / MCA (Freshers & Experienced welcome, no GPA cutoffs)

preparation_guide.selection_process: Round 1: General Aptitude & C/Java Debugging -> Round 2: Basic Programming -> Round 3: Advanced Problem Solving / Design -> Round 4: Tech HR -> Round 5: Culture Fit.
syllabus: Algorithms & Data Structures: Arrays, Strings, Matrices, Recursion, Pointers
Object Oriented Design: Inheritance, Polymorphism, Clean Code Principles
System Architecture: Database normalization, concurrency basics
key_topics: Zero-framework logic: Zoho tests raw algorithmic thinking rather than framework buzzwords
Solving pattern-matching, string manipulations, and game simulations (e.g. Tic-Tac-Toe, Snake, Railway Reservation)
Time and Space complexity optimization
preparation_guide.study_roadmap: Practice 50+ problems in pure C, C++, or Java without using high-level built-in shortcut functions (e.g., implement your own string parsing and sorting routines).
preparation_guide.career_ops_tips: Zoho values practical problem-solvers over academic credentials. Be ready to write clean, working code on paper or plain text editors during in-person rounds.

title: Cloud & DevOps Automation Specialist
qualification: B.E / B.Tech / MCA with knowledge of Linux, Docker, Python or Cloud platforms

preparation_guide.selection_process: Online HackerRank Assessment -> Technical Screening -> System Architecture Interview -> Leadership Round.
syllabus: Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes basics
Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
Scripting: Bash, Python, Linux administration
key_topics: Automated deployment pipelines and microservice monitoring
Cloud security best practices (IAM, VPC networks)
Automotive IoT and telemetry cloud ingestion architectures
preparation_guide.study_roadmap: Build an end-to-end CI/CD project on GitHub that tests, containerizes, and deploys a simple microservice automatically.
preparation_guide.career_ops_tips: Use CareerOps resume tailoring to highlight concrete automation metrics (e.g., 'reduced deployment cycle from 2 hours to 8 minutes').

title: Automobile Production & Quality Assurance Trainee
qualification: Diploma or B.E / B.Tech in Mechanical, Automobile, Mechatronics, or Production Engineering

preparation_guide.selection_process: Aptitude & Technical MCQ Test -> Group Discussion -> Technical Panel Interview -> Medical Checkup.
syllabus: Automobile Engineering: IC Engines, Transmission systems, Electric Vehicle (EV) battery architectures
Production Technology: Welding (Robotic Spot Welding), Paint Shop processes, Press Shop
Quality Control: Six Sigma, 5S, Kaizen, SPC, GD&T
key_topics: Modern Electric Vehicle (EV) powertrain fundamentals
Root cause analysis techniques (Fishbone diagram, 5-Why analysis)
Industrial safety regulations and OSHA norms
preparation_guide.study_roadmap: Revise manufacturing technology and automotive mechanics coursework, especially practical shop-floor tooling.
preparation_guide.career_ops_tips: Highlight any industrial visits, in-plant training (IPT), or hands-on workshop experience in your CV.

title: Graduate & Diploma Engineer Trainee (Civil & Structural)
qualification: Diploma or B.E / B.Tech in Civil Engineering

preparation_guide.selection_process: Online Technical & Aptitude Exam -> Technical Interview -> HR Interview.
syllabus: Structural Analysis, Strength of Materials, Concrete Technology
Surveying, Geotechnical Engineering, Transportation & Highway Design
Project Management: Primavera / MS Project, Quantity Estimation
key_topics: IS Code standards for reinforced concrete design (IS 456)
Quality testing of cement, aggregates, and steel rebar
Site safety protocols and bridge/metro infrastructure techniques
preparation_guide.study_roadmap: Focus on IS 456 design fundamentals and practical site-based engineering questions.
preparation_guide.career_ops_tips: Demonstrate willingness to work in diverse project site environments across Tamil Nadu.

title: Healthcare Operations & Patient Care Executive
qualification: Any Degree / BBA / MBA Healthcare / B.Sc / M.Sc Life Sciences

preparation_guide.selection_process: Personal Interview followed by Communication and Scenario-Handling Assessment.
syllabus: Hospital Information Systems (HIS), Electronic Health Records (EHR)
Medical terminology and patient service etiquette
Healthcare insurance claim processing (TPA, Ayushman Bharat, TN CMCHIS)
key_topics: Patient triage management and empathy in crisis resolution
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS) guidelines
Hospital emergency codes and accreditation standards (NABH/JCI)
preparation_guide.study_roadmap: Understand hospital workflow from admission to discharge and learn the basics of medical insurance schemes.
preparation_guide.career_ops_tips: Highlight fluent Tamil and English communication skills and any public-facing customer or patient assistance experience.

title: Global Banking Operations & Financial Crime Compliance
qualification: B.Com / BBA / M.Com / MBA Finance / Any Graduate with analytical background

preparation_guide.selection_process: Online Numerical & Logical Reasoning Assessment -> Video Interview -> Technical & Managerial Round.
syllabus: Financial Accounting, Banking Operations, International Payments (SWIFT)
Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), Sanctions Screening
Excel Modeling: VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Conditional Formulas
key_topics: Global regulatory compliance (FATF recommendations, RBI guidelines)
Trade finance instruments (Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees)
Data analysis using MS Excel and reporting dashboards
preparation_guide.study_roadmap: Master Excel formulas and study the fundamentals of KYC/AML compliance workflows.
preparation_guide.career_ops_tips: Demonstrate strict attention to detail in your resume and discuss risk mitigation in operational banking.
